title: Cost Optimization
description: Make agents cheap to run. Reduce token usage, maximize ROI.

title: Safety & Boundaries
description: Prevent hallucinations, toxic output. Keep agents aligned.

title: Observability
description: Debug agent behavior. Understand what your agents are doing.

title: Logging & Tracing
description: Recording what an agent actually did, step by step, after the fact.

title: Incident Response
description: What to do in the first ten minutes after an agent does something wrong.

title: Deploying
description: Run an agent somewhere other than your own machine, safely — matching hosting to real duration, triggering it without overlap or feedback loops, scoping and rotating its credentials, isolating its blast radius, and rolling out changes without breaking runs already in flight.

title: Cost Control
description: Keep an autonomous system from spending money without limit — knowing exactly where tokens go in a run, enforcing per-run and per-day budgets, routing cheap steps to cheap models, caching what doesn't change, and catching the runaway loop before it produces the bill.

title: Seeing What It Did
description: Instrument runs so any one of them can be reconstructed afterwards — tracing every step's input and output, knowing what never to log, finding the one bad run among thousands, alerts worth waking up for, and debugging a run from three weeks ago.
